sentences.text: Just as it is impossible to know when a swimming fish is drinking water, so it is quite difficult for the Court/Tribunal to find out when a police official/ IO had tinkered with the investigation to move it away from the truth to a desired conclusion but in the present case, it is clear that even after the complaint was made by the petitioner against Bimal Singh as the driver of the offending bus, only on the basis of unverified statement of father of the petitioner and without doing any substantive investigation, the charge-sheet has been filed against Rajender Singh as an accused/ driver of the offending bus and on the balance of probability, the Tribunal is of the opinion that by way of examination of the IO under section 168 of BSA, the IO has been caught in his legerdemain to transplant Rajender Singh in place of Bimal Singh as the driver of the offending bus.
Thus, it is held that the petitioner suffered injuries in the present accident due to rash and negligent driving of the driver Bimal Singh.

26. The petitioner is consistent with his stance from the beginning even till today that at the time of accident it was Bimal Singh who was driving the offending bus and not his father Rajender Singh.

After taking into consideration the material that is before the Tribunal, the Tribunal is of the opinion that in all probability the IO in collusion/conspiracy with the respondent no.1 (Rajender Singh) and respondent no.2 (Rama Shanakar) has projected the Rajender Singh as the driver of the offending bus at the time of the accident.
